node.statement: The remaining relevant producer hypotheses are precisely those used by lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope in the parent construction: the same A,w and partition state, nonempty U and j in the same equivalence class, the induction reset bounds, and epsilon<=W.e_s2/W.K2; its output is the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum at t_2 in A_R. Apply the single aggregate Stage-2 implication in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger to that producer output and the bounds from node 1.1.3.1.2.1. It directly supplies the literal u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism with ||u_2(I)-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_2 and reset eligibility. This argument neither invokes lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension separately nor asserts C_s2^0*e_2<=e_ext or (C_ext+1)*C_s2^0*e_2<=e_iso_unit.
